Mrs. Anna Creech also has a fine daughter. Mrs. Jennie Tull died last month, and they very sorry I feel for poor Mary. She takes it so hard. Mrs. Wyche sent me some very pretty mats and a little crochet sack for little Mamie. I came very near losing her neck yesterday morning with camphor and oh! such a time I had for a while. I have but very little time now to sew. My dear little Baby occupies most of my time, Nov 16th Sunday. 3-Saturday I am alone this evening. Mr. Sam went in Town this morning to preaching.
